Title: Analysis of Drain Bias Dependence of 1/f Noise in HV-MOSFETs
PublicationSource: 2015 International Conference on Noise and Fluctuations (ICNF)
ShortAbstract: Examines drain-bias-dependent flicker noise in high-voltage N- and P-MOSFETs, distinguishing channel and drift-region contributions across operating regimes.
